verdict.rationale: NVIDIA Project G-Assist is described as an on-device AI assistant that analyzes system data to 'tune, control, and optimize your system,' which loosely matches AI-generated insights/suggestions from data, but this is narrowly scoped to system/game settings rather than general user data. Missing for 10: evidence of broader data-analysis capabilities, examples of specific insights/suggestions generated, and independent hands-on validation of G-Assist's insight quality.
